newsitem.title: POLAND: BPH ups credit rates by two points.
newsitem.headline: BPH ups credit rates by two points.

text.p: Poland's Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy SA will on June 2 increase credit rates on already existing loans by two percentage points after the central bank raised obligatory reserves on zloty term deposits, BPH said on Monday.
BPH said it would leave deposit rates unchanged and increase credit rates on new loans as of May 6.

From April 30 the central bank increased the mandatory reserve requirement on zloty term deposits by two points to 11 percent and reserves on foreign currency deposits by one point to five percent to cool quickly growing domestic demand.
